newsitem.title: UK: Russian seaborne gasoil exports rise in Feb-Petrak.
newsitem.headline: Russian seaborne gasoil exports rise in Feb-Petrak.

text.p: Seaborne exports of Russian gas oil from the Black Sea ports of Novorossiisk, Tuapse and Odessa and the Baltic port of Ventspils rose by about 9.3 percent in February, shipping inspectors Petrak said.
Gas oil exports from the four ports totalled 1.389 million tonnes in February compared with 1.271 million tonnes in January.
No exports were seen out of Odessa in February compared with 60,853 tonnes in January when three tankers picked up product from the port.
The other Black Sea ports of Tuapse and Novorossiisk saw respective increases in February of 400,000 tonnes (305,000 in January) and 140,476 tonnes (135,656 in January).
Exports out of Ventspils, the major export outlet in the north, rose to 848,000 tonnes from 769,390 tonnes.
